name: press-button
title: Press a button
description: Press an annotated appliance button with the closed fingertips and retract: the microwave door key, the microwave start key, or the stove power key (which toggles the burner).
use_when: A button (microwave keys, stove power key) must be pressed.

not_to_be_confused_with.heat: heat guarantees a temperature; press guarantees only the key press.
not_to_be_confused_with.open: open guarantees the door is open.

applicability.summary: Requires hand_empty(hand=right); base_near(place=@button.appliance). Some bound nouns add preconditions (see Conditions that depend on the bound nouns).

preconditions.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).

postconditions.meaning: A measured press of this button happened during the Contract.

preconditions.meaning: Joint within 0.10 rad (doors) or 4 cm (drawers) of closed.

postconditions.meaning: The appliance's heat source is on (microwave cycle or stove burner).

failure.on_failure: stop and report the measured pre/postconditions; nothing is retried.

returns.success: true when every precondition held, the action ran and every postcondition holds
returns.error_code: on failure: INPUT_MISSING, INPUT_UNKNOWN, PRECONDITION_FAILED, NO_PATH, POLICY_FAILED, SUBSKILL_FAILED or POSTCONDITION_FAILED
returns.preconditions: each precondition as evaluated before moving, with holds = true/false
returns.postconditions: each postcondition as evaluated after the action, with holds = true/false
returns.outputs: the measured values listed under Outputs
